headers_that_matter.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: DELETE, GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, PUT

notes: contract change: all OPTIONS responses are 204 with an empty body and an Allow header (previously Flask's automatic OPTIONS answered 200). A 204 carries no Content-Length.

Same 204-empty response with or without CORS preflight request headers; the Access-Control-Allow-* headers appear only when Origin matches CORS_ORIGINS (the CORS layer is a non-short-circuiting after-request hook, so preflights ride the router's 204).
